title: Gasoline engine preference and recharge inconvenience
summary: Reviews in this topic combine comments about preferring or judging gasoline powertrains with EV recharge practicality, while several fragments are too brief or context-limited to support a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise either having no need for gasoline in the EV or a preference for a gasoline model option.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the gasoline engine for lacking desired power.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the gasoline engine, gasoline smell, or frequent recharging without enough context to classify the overall sentiment reliably.

limitations: This topic mixes partly unrelated subjects, including gasoline engine preference, gasoline odor, and EV charging inconvenience.
Several fragments are very short or lack surrounding context, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 reviews.
